architecture: in-process native plugin (dbghelp.dll proxy loaded by enshrouded_server.exe under Wine/Proton) exposing a loopback HTTP API, plus a Node.js sidecar that speaks the Takaro Generic Connector Protocol
runtime: enshrouded_server.exe game build 1024233 (Steam build 23178631) in mornedhels/enshrouded-server; plugin 0.4.2

statusDefinitions.proven: observed end-to-end via MCP plus game-side check
statusDefinitions.partial: works on one side, not proven end-to-end via MCP
statusDefinitions.pending: not implemented or not tested yet

getPlayerLocation.note: MCP playerongameserverSearch position + trackingGetPlayerMovementHistory; matches start spawn point within 0.2 m and follows teleports

getPlayerInventory.note: MCP trackingGetPlayerInventoryHistory matches in-game backpack (Ward_T1 level 5, arrows 26, club); Takaro history records changes only, so the unchanged starter legs (equipment) never appear there; plugin returns them

giveItem.note: non-admin player; game ignores count, plugin splits into full-stack + single actions (max 64); Admin-group player: give x5 + x4 arrived in client, a later client-driven backpack move was accepted server-side, no crash. Persistence across restart not verified (server was hard-killed before save and the character rolled back)

listItems.note: 3609 items via syncItems job, MCP itemSearch

listEntities.note: 979 templates, Takaro stored 977 (2 duplicate codes), MCP entitySearch; static data, live entity list only as /debug/nearby

listLocations.note: 1031 locations via plugin and sidecar adapter; Takaro app-api never calls listLocations and MCP has no location tool, so not observable via MCP

executeConsoleCommand.note: plugin-defined command set (help, players, say, whisper, location, teleport, tp, inventory, give, item, kick, save-and-shutdown); no settime

sendMessage.note: broadcast proven (renders as "<character name of an online player>: text"). Whisper reaches the recipient, but exclusion of other players is NOT verified: only one player account is available. Accepted limitation (user decision 2026-09-14)

teleportPlayer.note: Takaro rounds coordinates to integers; game nudges to a free voxel spot

kickPlayer.note: Friends group (0.3.0, 0.4.1, 0.4.2) and Admins group (0.4.2) proven via MCP + client 'The host has kicked you from the session.'. Plugin <=0.4.1 silently did nothing for Admins/canKickBan players: the game's own handler skips them; 0.4.2 lifts that check for the one call. MCP returns {} for success and for plugin errors alike

banPlayer.note: online players only; reason/expiresAt not supported by the game. Re-proven 2026-09-14 on 0.4.2 with an Admins-group player (ban dialog, bannedAccounts entry, rejoin refused)

unbanPlayer.note: requires the player to have been seen online once (hash cache); re-proven 2026-09-14 on 0.4.2 (unban log line, list empty, rejoin succeeded)

player-connected.note: stored records 7f2fa9b2, 4038ab40 from real joins; playerOnboarding hook fired from them

player-disconnected.note: stored 7757b852 from a real leave; 9b618661 from sidecar reconciliation after the server was killed with the player online

log.note: not a stored/searchable Takaro event; arrival only shown by event-rate-limited records (697530ba, limitedEventType log, droppedCount 231)

player-death.note: fall death and death by enemy proven earlier. Non-player killer is now forwarded in the base msg field ('<name> was killed by <code>'; Takaro schema has no killerEntity and forbids unknown fields). Unit-tested only; not re-proven live after the change

entity-killed.note: weapon is empty (weapon category not mapped); props/voxel destructibles are filtered out

command.note: real in-game chat with '@' prefix (utils ping, custom ensproof); '/', '!' also pass through

hook.note: real chat-message, real player-connected (playerOnboarding) and MCP hookTrigger

cronjob.note: MCP cronjobTrigger (message seen in client) and natural scheduled runs 20:05, 20:10

teleports.note: @settp/@tp/@tplist/@deletetp; position change confirmed by plugin, server log, MCP pog and screenshots

playerOnboarding.note: join-time welcome is sent while the client is still loading and was not seen on screen; the same hook run via hookTrigger in game was seen

chatBridge.note: built-in chatBridge: D1, D4 and a human D2 proven. Replaced on this server by chatBridgeNoEcho (5ca72768) because of the Takaro-core echo

chatBridgeNoEcho.note: fork of chatBridge. GameToDiscord skips player-less chat. No echo proven, and player chat still relayed

containerRestartReconnect.note: reachability false during restart, sidecar self-exit after 180 s, reconnected, connectable:true

sidecarRestartNoReplay.note: cursor 693 persisted; no Takaro records created by the restart; new chat after restart forwarded once

pluginRestartDetection.note: seq-reset path proven live (0.4.0); plugin 0.4.1 adds bootId (cursor now stores it, used live after redeploy); bootId-only case unit-tested

signatureSelfCheckDegrade.note: debug build with corrupted addComponent pattern: teleport=degraded, all other capabilities ok, server kept running, MCP reachability reason 'capabilities not ok: teleport=degraded'; release 0.4.1 restored with all ok. Degraded teleport request not exercised with a player online
